reason: Magnesium before bed is something I actually want, and the named lab with the batch report behind the QR code is more than most TikTok supplements show. The $24.99 launch price and the money-back guarantee make one box an easy impulse buy, but only once.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer. I'd be paying extra for the lab report and the sachets, and I'm not sure I'd keep paying full price every month.
